adoption: Separate sample-search version; historical model and interrupted full-data study remain preserved.

protocol.budget: The same thirty predeclared XGBoost configurations in each of four strategies. Each strategy is tuned independently; no inherited winning settings or prefix shortcuts.
protocol.control_semantics: Original five hyperparameter settings rebuilt with the explicitly versioned train-only phase-51 preprocessing; not asserted identical to the historical fitted binary or its metrics.
protocol.preprocessing: Phase-51 train-only vocabulary and categorical splits; fit once per strategy and reuse its transformed train/validation inputs across independent estimator fits.
protocol.probability_calibration: Raw probabilities only; no recalibration. Diagnostic calibration metrics never modify predictions.
protocol.scope: A finite XGBoost-only sample study. It neither completes nor overwrites the interrupted full-training study, and does not silently replace the historical reference.
protocol.selection: Minimum unrounded 2023 validation log loss; exact ties by candidate_id. Select one finalist independently per strategy, then one winner across the four frozen finalists.
protocol.test_status: 2024 was previously inspected. All four finalists and the fixed original-settings control are frozen before exploratory test comparison; test scores cannot change selection.
protocol.threshold_metrics: Threshold 0.5 is descriptive; candidate selection uses probabilities through log loss.
protocol.training: The same committed 200,000 real training records before any balancing; validation and test are complete and never resampled.
protocol.trial_order: Original hyperparameter vector first in each arm; remaining vectors in the declared fixed JSON order.

selection.rule: Minimum unrounded 2023 validation log loss; exact ties by candidate_id. Select one finalist independently per strategy, then one winner across the four frozen finalists.
